text:
samir patel: FYI I'm updating the `hello-deploy` quickstart to use the SDK v8 auth helpers and to add a short container deploy note. I put up a draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3490. Running it locally I hit an auth mismatch (401). Anyone seen this?

emily ho: Nice. Error dump?

samir patel: The server logs show \"missing API key\". Turns out the example still references REDWOOD_TOKEN in the Dockerfile and README. New SDK uses REDWOOD_API_KEY and the helper createClientFromEnv.

daniel kim: We changed the helper names last quarter, yep. For quickstarts we usually show the minimal env export + 1-line helper call. Keeps examples concise.

nora singh: Also add a short KMS pointer for enterprise customers who use instance credentials. We had a support case where missing that line caused confusion.

emily ho: Can we show both a Node and Python snippet? And include a one-liner bash export for mac/linux.

samir patel: Will do. Planning to: 1) replace REDWOOD_TOKEN -> REDWOOD_API_KEY, 2) swap client instantiation to createClientFromEnv(), 3) restore Dockerfile --build-arg usage and add a secrets callout.

docs-ci-bot: CI started for PR #3490 — lint, linkcheck, mdspell.

docs-ci-bot: linkcheck: error: docs/quickstart/hello-deploy.md line 38 -> https://old-auth.example/ (404 redirect).

samir patel: thanks bot. I'll update that link to /docs/authentication and add a note to cross-link enterprise KMS.

daniel kim: For Docker guidance, add a short caution: don't bake secrets into image layers; recommend ARG + runtime env injection or a secret manager. Link to /docs/security/secrets.
nora singh: Also add a one-line example for BuildKit: `docker build --build-arg REDWOOD_API_KEY=$REDWOOD_API_KEY --secret id=redwood_api_key,src=/run/secrets/redwood_api_key .` — but keep it optional.
emily ho: Snippet suggestions: Node minimal:
```js
import { createClientFromEnv } from '@redwood/inference-sdk';
const client = createClientFromEnv();
const r = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-v1', prompt: 'hello' });
console.log(r.text);
```
Python minimal:
```py
from redwood_inference import create_client_from_env
client = create_client_from_env()
r = client.generate(model='redwood-v1', prompt='hello')
print(r.text)
```
samir patel: Added those. Also a tiny bash block:
```bash
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=\"<YOUR_KEY>\"
# optional for KMS customers: export REDWOOD_KMS_KEY=\"projects/...\"
```

daniel kim: One nit: prefer `REDWOOD_API_KEY` unquoted in examples to avoid shell escaping issues when copy/pasting in docs.
nora singh: And add a reminder under the container section: \"If you must pass keys during build, prefer BuildKit secrets or ARG and never commit keys.\" Link to the secrets page.
samir patel: Fixed the bash formatting and added the admonition + link. Also updated the Dockerfile example to include `ARG REDWOOD_API_KEY` and a comment about runtime injection.
emily ho: Great. Can you assign me + nora as reviewers and add a TODO to open a follow-up issue to add a CI smoke check that builds the quickstart examples (no real keys, just build & lint)?
samir patel: Assigned reviewers and added \"TODO: CI smoke check\" to the PR description. Pushed an extra commit that squashes the minor wording nits.
docs-ci-bot: mdspell: passed. linkcheck: warning: redirect found for /docs/authentication -> /docs/auth. Consider updating link target.
samir patel: Replaced with /docs/auth to avoid redirect. Squashed and pushed.
docs-ci-bot: All checks passed for PR #3490. Ready for review.
emily ho: Quick pass LGTM. Small suggestion to trim the long paragraph in the Auth section and keep it to two concise bullets.
samir patel: Trimmed and pushed.
daniel kim: Want me to backport the link fix to hello-chat and hello-embed while we're at it?
emily ho: Yes, please — it'll save separate PR churn.
samir patel: Opening backport PRs after merge.

emily ho: If CI remains green, can we merge and trigger a patch redeploy to staging? I'll merge when I'm back at my desk in ~30 mins.
samir patel: Sounds good. Thanks for the quick turnaround.
docs-ci-bot: PR #3490 merged by emily ho — site deploy queued.
docs-ci-bot: deploy: staging build started 2026-04-02T14:05:00Z
samir patel: Verified staging site render; snippets show correctly and Docker note present. Will watch prod deploy.
emily ho: Thanks everyone. Small wins like this make onboarding smoother. Closing thread after backports opened.
